title: Financial sustainability planning toolkit for Diamond OA journals
what_changed: EIFL published a Financial sustainability planning toolkit for Diamond OA journals: three complementary resources that help editorial teams turn good practice into a complete, credible three-year sustainability plan for parent institutions and funders.
why_it_matters: Diamond OA journals charge neither authors nor readers, so financial sustainability is their structural weak point; practical planning resources are what funders and institutions ask for before committing support.
